item.title: 0.1.7 Beta 8.5
item.description:
# SakuraCord v0.1.7-Beta-8.5
## SakuraCord v0.1.7 Beta 8.5 (macOS 26 port)
Unofficial macOS 26.5 build of SakuraCord nightly, put together by UnxnownYT.
### New - Rich activity, from upstream PR #528 by DinanathDash: - Spotify and Apple Music "Listening to" status, read straight from the apps (no account connection needed), with album art and progress. - Local Discord RPC: games and apps that support Discord Rich Presence show on your status. - Other people's activity (games, music) on their profile cards. - Privacy controls in Settings → Privacy & Safety (off by default).
### Fixed (port) - The GIF button, the Discord/GitHub/thread icons, the About logo and the profile badges were missing on macOS 26. - Local RPC now works inside the macOS sandbox.
### Notes - Ad-hoc signed. On first launch, right-click → Open (or allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security). - Updates: this build checks the nightly feed. Use Check for Updates… for the next nightly.
